# Mercer County Community College (MCCC)

> > Mercer County Community College is a two-year community college in West Windsor, New Jersey, offering degree programs, transfer pathways, and athletics through the Vikings sports teams.

MCCC serves students across Mercer County with campuses in West Windsor and Trenton (James Kerney Campus), providing academic programs in fields like advertising, architecture, computer science, engineering, and business administration. The college supports international students, transfer students, and student-athletes while offering comprehensive enrollment services and career coaching.
